# ProKit Studio Docs

ProKit Studio is the core runtime layer in this repository. These docs define runtime and infrastructure contracts, the recommended stack, and the optional integrations you can enable on top of the engine.

## Public docs (buyer-facing)

- `docs-public/overview.md` – product positioning and stack highlights; Supabase + Vercel remain the reference example layer, but any Postgres-compatible provider and host that supports Node 18+ is supported.
- `docs-public/development.md` – canonical getting-started guide with prerequisites, quick start, and local workflow.
- `docs-public/features.md` – complete functional feature census with direct code callouts.
- `docs-public/database.md` – database contract and Prisma migration checklist.
- `docs-public/scripts.md` – public script surface that outlines runtime, deploy, and migration commands.
- `docs-public/deployment.md` – deployment stance with production startup guardrail, including Vercel-specific build behavior.
- `docs-public/optional-features.md` – high-level summary of optional Clerk, Stripe, and Resend integrations.
- `docs-public/architecture.md` – runtime boundaries, route structure, and migration flow.
- `docs-public/git-workflow.md` – branch-based release and rollback guidance.

## Public reference stack

- Supabase for managed Postgres (default example)
- Vercel for deploy-on-push hosting

These are recommendations, not lock-in instructions.

## Private docs

- `docs-private/ENGINE_SYNC_NOTES.md` – engine contract policies for runtime/database/deploy behavior.
- `docs-private/ai-prompts-dev.md` – AI prompt block for Codex/AI helpers.
- `docs-private/feature-diff-saaskit-vs-prokit.md` – internal comparison with SaaSKit.
- `docs-private/roadmap.md` – lightweight backlog and experiments.
- `docs-private/optional-features.md` – internal operational view before public sanitization.
- `docs-private/instructions/` – Clerk, Stripe, and troubleshooting instructions (private).
- `docs-private/modules/` – module templates and optional module patterns (private).
